structure: Home Page: Giant procedural WebGL Canvas AI Orb centered, Turkish prompt input box below, shortcut keys HUD, smooth bottom-to-top curtain transition to Chat view
Chat Page: Minimalist, clean conversation view with streaming status, SSE support, voice state indicators, message history, clear/reset, export options

Cowork Page: macOS Traffic Light Window Chrome (Red/Yellow/Green interactive controls), tabbed OS interface containing Notes, Calculator, Terminal, Memory Browser, Approvals, Council Members, Provider Settings, Checkpoints, Coding Studio, Diagnostics
Persistent Bottom-Right Orb Widget: Mini procedural canvas orb with state synchronization (idle, listening, thinking, streaming, error) accessible from anywhere
Global Command Palette (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K): Keyboard-first command palette with Turkish quick actions for navigation, model switching, memory lookup, and tool triggering

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium dark-graphite futuristic Turkish-language frontend interface for J.A.R.V.I.S.
Implement real working interactive controls for all 3 main pages (Home, Chat, Cowork) and floating bottom-right Orb.

Ensure all user-facing strings are in natural Turkish language (e.g. 'J.A.R.V.I.S Sistemine Hoş Geldiniz', 'Komut veya soru yazın...', 'Cowork Çalışma Alanı', 'Sistem Tanılama', 'Sözleşme ve Onaylar', 'Jarvis yazdı').
Use Electric Blue (#00A3FF) and Cyan glow (#00F0FF) over Deep Graphite (#090A0F) background.

Connect to FastAPI backend endpoints (/api/chat, /api/notes, /api/approvals, /api/council, /api/providers, /api/memory, /api/coding-studio, /api/diagnostics) with robust fallback/mock support if specific endpoints are initializing.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, input, tab, card, modal, and key status element following kebab-case role conventions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use pure black (#000) or generic gray gradients. Use deep graphite with electric blue glass accents.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk for dashboard body text; use JetBrains Mono or Inter.
Provide responsive layouts for mobile and desktop screens with custom scrollbars and backdrop-blur effects.
Ensure high APCA accessibility contrast on buttons, inputs, and tab items.
